title: Sea Vous Play | Designer WaterColor Home | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Sea Vous Play is a pet-friendly WaterColor home just 100 yards to Camp WaterColor, with bikes, a golf cart, designer interiors, and outdoor living spaces.
description_expanded: Sea Vous Play Designer Retreat Steps from Camp WaterColor Home Introduction Welcome to Sea Vous Play , a beautifully designed retreat in the Camp District of WaterColor . Located less than 100 yards from Camp WaterColor, this stunning coastal home blends luxury, comfort, and convenience with elegant interiors, inviting outdoor spaces, and access to world-class resort amenities . Thoughtfully designed for families and groups , Sea Vous Play features two spacious primary suites, multiple indoor gathering spaces, and charming porches that embrace the relaxed outdoor lifestyle of 30A. Whether you are enjoying lazy afternoons at Camp WaterColor, biking to the beach, or unwinding on the screened porch after sunset, this home delivers the perfect beach vacation experience. Home Highlights Less than 100 yards to Camp WaterColor with access included Complimentary 6-seater LSV (golf cart) included with stay (waiver required) Access to 4 Taxi Bikes Pet friendly for up to 2 dogs, 60 pounds or less, with approval and fee required Gourmet kitchen with Thermador appliances, wine fridge, and standalone ice maker Two spacious primary suites including a first-floor king suite with spa bath and sitting room Screened back porch with outdoor dining, cushioned seating, and ceiling fans Covered front porch with bench swing, lounge chairs , and gated entry for little ones Main living room with plush seating, swivel captain's chairs, and Smart TV Upstairs TV nook perfect for movie nights Sonos sound system throughout the home Enclosed outdoor shower Outdoor grill for family cookouts Parking for 2 to 3 vehicles Complete Clean Linen Program with all linens laundered after every stay Location Perks 1 minute bike ride to Camp WaterColor pools, lazy river, and waterslides 5 minute bike or LSV ride to the WaterColor Beach Club Directly across from Camp Field for soccer, football, and family picnics Minutes from 30A dining, shopping, coffee shops, and beach access points Know Before You Go Access to Camp WaterColor, WaterColor Beach Club, and neighborhood pools is included with your reservation Community pools are seasonally heated during cooler months and subject to neighborhood operations A mid-stay clean is required for reservations 10 days or longer and is included in your rate Additional concierge services available including beach bonfires, bike rentals, beach chair setups, and chef experiences Exterior security cameras may be present for property protection purposes only ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***

2nd Floor King Suite | Ensuite bath with walk-in shower
2nd Floor Guest Suite | Sleeps up to 4 in two Double beds, TV, ensuite access to shared full bath with walk-in shower
2nd Floor Guest Room | Sleeps 2 in two twin beds, adjacent to shared full bath with walk-in shower
